summary: Mobile Expo preview loaded onboarding and auth screens, but the QA login UI stayed on an indefinite spinner while the same public login API succeeds directly.

ui_bugs.issue: After entering the provided QA credentials and tapping Masuk ke SyntaxAI, the button remains in loading state and the app does not navigate or show an error.
ui_bugs.testID: missing; login button has no testID

integration_issues.flow: Onboarding skip -> QA login -> authenticated Home
integration_issues.issue: UI login did not produce a request visible in backend logs and remained indefinitely busy, although POST /api/auth/login returns 200 for the same credentials via the public endpoint.

action_items: Debug the web client API URL/fetch path and ensure Auth submit always resolves or times out into an error; verify login sends POST /api/auth/login and redirects to /(tabs).
Add testID attributes to auth inputs, mode controls, submit button, and key tab/screen elements for regression coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: src/api.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while the requested environment contract names EXPO_BACKEND_URL; verify the deployed Expo bundle uses the intended variable and does not resolve an empty or stale URL.
Auth submit has no request timeout, so a failed/hanging fetch leaves busy=true indefinitely.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use 390x844. Fresh public preview opened /onboarding, skip reached /auth. QA credentials are in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Direct requests POST https://code-master-app-6.preview.emergentagent.com/api/auth/login returned 200, but UI login stayed on spinner and no corresponding backend POST appeared in logs.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open public preview in a fresh session, tap Lewati untuk sekarang, fill qa.syntaxai@gmail.com and Belajar123!, tap Masuk ke SyntaxAI. The button changes to spinner and remains there after 2.5s; URL remains /auth. Backend direct login works. Likely client-side API URL/environment resolution or fetch behavior, compounded by missing timeout/error fallback in submit.
